verdict.rationale: Vanta has a dedicated Third-Party Risk Management product. Its TPRM Agent discovers vendors (the inventory), accelerates assessments, and monitors third-party risk. It also pulls findings from vendor SOC 2 reports, DPAs, and questionnaires, which covers the security-posture review in place of a spreadsheet. missing for 10: explicit evidence of tracking each vendor's data access, documented vendor review-cadence scheduling or reminders (the only reminder claim is on the general risk page), in-depth docs beyond marketing pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
